title: Required Integration Lanes
problem: Relevant sport critical and browser integration lanes can be skipped on pull requests, while the required final gate accepts skipped as equivalent to tested for those in-scope lanes.
root_cause: Sport critical jobs were PR-deferred unless model math changed, browser QA was push-only, root sport-specific Streamlit files could be classified as core, and the final gate had no touched-domain rule requiring success for in-scope integration lanes.
patch: Classify token-bound sport ownership in root router names, keep sport-owned Streamlit files out of generic core, run touched sport critical lanes and UI/core browser QA on pull requests, and fail the final gate whenever an in-scope required lane is not success.
